This opportunity resides with All\-Domain Operations (ADO), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All\-Domain Operations comprises multi\-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.
  
  

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision\-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.
  
  

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies
  
  

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:
  
  

Know \& Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.
  
  

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

HII\-Mission Technologies is seeking an Intelligence Analyst to join our Operations Support Team (OST) located at the Ft. Meade and Annapolis Junction, Maryland locations. This critical position is part of a 24/7 Help Desk team of technicians that is required to maintain optimal posture of SIGINT systems across a wide range of AORs. The OST Intelligence Analyst diagnoses, troubleshoots, and rectifies any faults for deployed sensors, and forwards unresolved issues to deployed Field Service Representatives (FSRs) with the correct diagnosis and the steps for repair.
  
  

The OST Intelligence Analyst serves as a point of contact for FSRs to gain assistance in troubleshooting deployed systems; provides on\-call reach\-back capability to mission managers, FSRs and system engineers for deployed assets; and resolves Service Requests (SRs) for system outages and troubleshooting. Additionally, they may be asked to provide onsite support activities for flight test operations at customer facilities. This includes conducting validations, installation of systems on platforms, loading and unloading equipment, monitoring tests on systems, equipment installation and testing, and setting up software servers. This requires travel to the customer facilities for up to two weeks per occurrence.
  
  

The OST Help Desk is operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Currently there are two modified Panama shifts of 12 hours each; the first shift begins at 6 am and ends at 6 pm. The second shift begins at 6 pm and ends at 6 am. Teams of technicians work an approximate rotating shift pattern of 2 days on / 2 days off; 5 days on / 5 days off. Operational teams will periodically switch between the first and second shifts (days and nights) every 2 months.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
Monitor multiple chatrooms for outages
  
Coordinate with operators, technicians, and engineers to troubleshoot issues
  
Maintenance of the outage/troubleshooting database
  
Identify software or hardware related flaws to engineers
  
Serve as a liaison for failure analysis and troubleshooting coordination with SIGINT operations and field service personnel
  
Provide real\-time overall fleet health status of SIGINT Mission equipment
  
Maintain Mission Status Log for DoD and other US Government entities
  
Review data in support of collection concept development
  
Maintain awareness of community activities impacting assignments
  
Independently write reports detailing methods, results, and impacts to assigned issues
  
Perform queries and analysis using national databases
  
Perform signals analysis research
  
Produce geo\-location data to support the development of various intelligence reports
  
Create data products and support/develop associated systems which heavily utilize technically derived data from multiple sources to include SIGINT, MASINT, IMINT, OSINT, and HUMINT
  
Train other members of the team on SIGINT fundamentals
  
What We Are Looking For
  
5 years of relevant experience with bachelor's in related field; 3 years of relevant experience with master's in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience
  
TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance
  
**Preferred:** Bonus Points For...
  
Mode 1, 2,3, 5, or 6 certified
  
Familiarity with AIRHANDLER and AIRHANDLER suite of systems

jobs.description:
Description:
**RMC is seeking a highly motivated** **Program Analyst** **to support our customers at the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia.**

  

Are you ready to embark on a fulfilling and impactful career journey with RMC Global? We're in search of an exceptional **Program Analyst** to become a part of our mission\-driven team, dedicated to making a difference in the federal and commercial markets. At RMC, we're all about enhancing security for both our military and global commercial partners, offering an array of services such as Risk Management, Mission Assurance, and Cybersecurity.

  

Our team's well\-being is paramount, and we reflect this commitment through our flexible work environment and exceptional company culture. By joining RMC, you become a key contributor to our mission – **Assuring Tomorrow!**

  

When you join RMC, you'll experience a range of benefits, including:

* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans fully covered for employees
	+ Subsidized dependent health care coverage
* Participation in our Annual Bonus Program
* Life insurance policy equivalent to 1x your annual salary.
* Company paid short and long\-term disability
* Cell phone reimbursement of $65 per month
* 401(k) Plan with contributions
* A 401(k) Safe Harbor Employer Contribution Program, which includes a 3% contribution

**Position Summary:**


The Program Analyst (PA) supports RMC’s military customers and program personnel, including the Mission Assurance Assessment and Utility Assessment teams worldwide. In this role, the PA provides technical and operational coordination, training, and support to a military headquarters entity, assisting Joint Service as needed. Responsibilities include planning, organizing, and preparing information briefs and point papers on policies, procedures, and operations, as well as reviewing military headquarters plans for compliance with DoD directives. Additionally, the PA offers administrative support to RMC Corporate Headquarters and gains expertise in various specialty areas, including Law Enforcement, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and High\-Yield Explosive protection, Antiterrorism, Physical Security, Information Sharing, Emergency Management, Supporting Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and Communications.

**Planning, Coordinating, and Executing Assessments:**

* Support military customer in the coordination, preparation, research and execution of assessments, events, activities to support Joint Staff, Navy, and Marine Corps Mission Assurance and its related programs and processes
* Assist with event planning, meetings, and conferences, including maintaining a master event calendar or spreadsheet, collecting RSVPs, and coordinating with external stakeholders
* Provide logistical and administrative support to RMC personnel for domestic and international travel as needed
* Schedule meetings with military installations

**DOD Product Development and Mission Assurance Support:**

* Support military customer in the preparation and review of graphical, oral, written reports, briefs, and products for multiple programs encompassed within the Mission Assurance umbrella
* Assist in the development and review of DoD reports and information papers, white papers, and position papers
* Assist in the coordination of staffing and research for DoD initiatives
* Draft briefs for internal and external use on various protection related topics
* Edit, proofread, and fact\-check various documents and reports
* Participate in conferences, meetings, and other events, as needed
* Sit\-in on working groups to develop program awareness and subject matter expertise

**RMC Office Administrative Duties:**

* Process RMC mail, maintaining and disseminating confidential information to the appropriate parties
* Work with PA Team to maintain a stock of shirts on hand for assessments and company events

* Assist in various administrative duties, as needed

* Assist in drafting, editing, proofreading, and guiding policy through a review process

**Security Coordination**

* Assist RMC personnel in Common Access Card (CAC) processing
* Assist RMC personnel gain access to NIPR and SIPR accounts
* Serve as a member of the Security Coordination Team
* Escorting RMC personnel onsite at Pentagon
* Access Defense Information Security System (DISS) and coordinate DISS data and/or security clearances as necessary for job requirements. Ensure the information in DISS is secured at the highest level. Keep DISS information confidential per the RMC Employee Non\-Disclosure Agreement

**Competencies:**

* Exhibits strong organizational skills and attention to detail, effectively prioritizing tasks and managing multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Develops clear and concise plans for completing projects and achieving objectives, utilizing superb research, analytical, writing, and editing skills
* Ability to draft and send professionally polished emails that convey key actions, needs, and recommendations
* Customer service\-oriented and experienced in providing support to client personnel while working collaboratively and constructively with team members

* Strong work ethic and independence; effectively applies technical knowledge to solve problems

jobs.description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Program Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
  

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.
  
  

Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer This critical role serves as the single accountable interface to the Government's Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and Contracting Officer, providing disciplined program management, governance, and Agile delivery leadership across a geographically distributed, 24x7 enterprise IT environment.
  
  

The Program Manager will oversee a broad portfolio of integrated IT services including enterprise Network Operations Center (NOC) operations, multi\-tier Help Desk/Service Desk support, network engineering, Microsoft infrastructure administration, AI/Perplexity integration, infrastructure and platform operations, enterprise application support, IT service management, and automation and analytics capabilities. This engagement is structured around an Agile, Sprint delivery model and requires a leader who can seamlessly integrate continuous 24x7 operational obligations with an Agile planning and prioritization cadence.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a seasoned federal IT program management professional with a demonstrated record of leading enterprise\-scale, multi\-functional IT operations programs, managing diverse cross\-functional teams, and delivering measurable service improvements in a complex federal environment.
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a background investigation, HSPD\-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be performed at customer Headquarters in Washington DC.
  
  

The Program Manager serves as the senior leader and primary contractor point of contact for all aspects of program execution, governance, staffing, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement. This individual is accountable for the successful delivery of all functional area objectives, contractual deliverables, service level commitments, and Sprint\-based level\-of\-effort obligations. The Program Manager leads the Contractor Program Office and provides overarching direction to all functional leads and technical teams operating under this engagement.

* Serve as the single accountable interface to the COR and Contracting Officer for all matters related to program performance, staffing, deliverables, risk, and compliance.
* Provide executive\-level program oversight across all thirteen functional areas, ensuring integrated, coordinated delivery that meets Government objectives for availability, user support, engineering, service management, and continual improvement.
* Develop, maintain, and execute the Program Management Plan and Agile Delivery and Staffing Plan, ensuring alignment with Government priorities and contractual requirements throughout the period of performance.
* Lead post\-award kickoff meeting planning, coordination, and execution, including development and delivery of the Post Award Meeting Agenda and Post Award Meeting Minutes.
* Oversee the development and timely submission of all contractual deliverables, including Sprint Plans, Sprint Review Reports, Sprint Retrospectives, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, service\-level/ITSM metrics dashboards, risk and issues registers, the Quality Control Plan, Transition\-In Plan, and Transition\-Out Plan.
* Maintain a current, prioritized program risk and issues register, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to program performance, coverage continuity, and service level achievement.
* Ensure all program activities comply with applicable Federal statutes, regulations, Executive Orders, FAR/DFARS requirements, GSA MAS contract terms and conditions, FISMA, NIST SP 800\-53, FedRAMP, HSPD\-12/FIPS 201, NIST SP 800\-207 Zero Trust Architecture, OMB M\-22\-09, and federal IT and cybersecurity policies.


**Agile Delivery Leadership:**  

* Lead the program's Agile operating model, ensuring effective integration of two\-week Sprint ceremonies—including Sprint Planning, daily coordination, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective—with continuous 24x7 operational obligations across the NOC and Service Desk.
* Oversee backlog management activities, ensuring a prioritized, groomed backlog is maintained in Government ITSM/Agile tooling and that Sprint commitments reflect accurate, achievable level\-of\-effort commitments each Sprint.
* Serve as the contractor's senior liaison to the COR or designated Government Product Owner for Sprint prioritization, backlog refinement, and roadmap execution activities.
* Ensure Sprint level\-of\-effort delivery meets or exceeds target and committed Sprint work items are completed each Sprint.
* Provide or assign Agile delivery leadership (Scrum Master or equivalent) from within the Contractor Program Office structure.

jobs.description:
C5ISRT Intelligence Analyst**The Opportunity:**

Our clients need skilled analysts to turn reams of data into actionable intelligence for our government and military every day. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem\-solving mindset, are familiar with cyberspace concepts and technical targeting, and are ready to help our nation's leaders understand the critical threats and opportunities facing our country, we have an opportunity for you as a C5ISRT Intelligence Analyst.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* 3\+ years of experience in technical targeting, network link analysis, and functional requirements
* Ability to develop high\-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
* TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
* HS diploma or GED and 7\+ years of experience in intelligence or cybersecurity, or Bachelor's degree and 3\+ years of experience in intelligence or cybersecurity

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience in computer engineering or network development
* Knowledge of cyberspace strategy, policy, and concepts
* Knowledge of the IC and Combatant Command environment
* Knowledge of the INDOPACOM AOR
* Ability to provide shift work support
* Ability to accept a 6\- or 12\-month rotation to another team and facility

**Clearance:**


Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

**Compensation**


At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.


Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000\.00 to $141,000\.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.**Identity Statement**


As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**


AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on **your** own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided**.


**Work Model**

**The Role**



The Intelligence Analyst is the senior analytical seat in the operation. You monitor an all\-hazards picture for client critical infrastructure across multiple sites in a disperse geographical areas severe weather, grid and utility disruption, civil unrest and protest activity, crime and targeted violence, unauthorized drone activity, transportation and supply disruption, wildfire, seismic activity, and public health events. You calculate what each event actually threatens, and you communicate that judgment to the people who act on it.



**Key Responsibilities**



**All\-Hazards Monitoring**



* Monitor a defined portfolio of sites continuously for natural, technological, human\-caused, and geopolitical hazards.



* Run open\-source intelligence collection across news, government, utility, meteorological, transportation, and social sources — and verify before you report.

* Assess every event against three factors — proximity to the site, severity of the hazard, and incident or risk type — and produce a defensible risk determination from them.

* Distinguish credible threats from noise. Explain the reasoning behind each call, not just the conclusion.

* Build trend analysis that identifies recurring risk exposure across the portfolio and informs mitigation planning.



* Document every assessment so it holds up on later review.

* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105\.65\-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. PenFed is hiring a (Hybrid) Business Analyst, Business Unit Accounting at our Tysons, Virginia location. * Generous Paid Time Off

jobs.title: CBRN Program Analyst
jobs.description:
At Battelle, experience matters, especially when addressing the complexities of chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosives (CBRNE) challenges. For over 70 years, government agencies and industries have trusted us to provide solutions for some of their most critical CBRNE issues. Battelle is home to advanced facilities and leading industry experts who deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from threat awareness to complex systems integration—ensuring the nation is prepared to respond to both current and emerging threats. Our commitment to safety and innovation makes us a leader in the field, dedicated to protecting national security and public safety.

**Job Summary**
---------------



We are currently seeking a CBRN Analyst. This position is a full\-time opportunity located in Washington, D.C. (Pentagon, client site).  

Battelle has been providing research, development, test, and evaluation services in support of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) defense for over 60 years. As part of our mission support, Battelle is working with the U.S. Army G8 – Capability Development (CD) Directorate to advance the resourcing, equipping, and modernization of CBRN defense capabilities. Our support facilitates the advancement of CBRND systems for next\-generation CBRN sensing, threat warning, reporting, hazard prediction, protection, and mitigation.


In this role, the selected individual will coordinate across integrated Layered Protection portfolios to align requirements, resources, acquisition activities, and senior leader engagement across the Services. They will also synchronize CBRN modernization efforts with broader Joint and Service initiatives, ensuring defense systems remain effective against evolving global threats.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



As a CBRN Analyst, the selected individual will serve as a key synchronization resource within the Chemical and Biological Defense Program, supporting the U.S. Army's Executive Agent responsibilities across military and interagency stakeholders. Responsibilities may include:

jobs.title: Project Manager - Design and Construction
jobs.description:
**ABOUT NOOKS**



Nooks is pioneering Classified\-Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission\-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We're growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

**About the Role**



You will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Nooks' physical spaces — from early design coordination through construction and handoff to Operations. This role exists because building accredited classified environments at speed and at scale requires a single owner who can hold scope, schedule, and budget across every site, translate Nooks' product standards into buildable solutions, and keep architects, engineers, and general contractors moving toward handoff. You will report into Nooks' Construction function within Product as an individual contributor, working from a remote or hybrid base with travel of up to 50% to project sites. In this role, you are an individual contributor as part of the Nooks Construction Team, under the VP of Product. You will work on a remote or hybrid basis with travel to project sites up to 50% of the time.



This is a builder role. While you'll have clearly defined ownership areas, priorities shift quickly in a fast\-moving, build\-heavy environment, and the right person steps into whatever the project needs — making decisions with imperfect information, improving the process as they go, and treating every build as a chance to make the next one more repeatable.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Design Coordination \& Documentation**


* Coordinate the full drawing process across schematic design, design development, and construction document (SD, DD, CD) phases, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to Nooks standards
* Partner with Product Security to translate program and accreditation requirements into buildable, repeatable solutions
* Review drawing sets with architects and engineers to resolve constructability issues before they reach the field


**Construction Execution**


* Oversee general contractors and vendors through construction, owning schedule tracking, site coordination, and issue resolution
* Review requests for information (RFIs), submittals, and change orders against design intent and budget before approval
* Lead permitting and approvals, managing submissions and comment responses to protect the schedule


**Project Controls \& Delivery**


* Own each project from early design through turnover, holding scope, schedule, and budget at every stage
* Track milestones and surface risks early, driving mitigation before they affect delivery
* Partner with Finance to monitor budgets, validate changes, and maintain financial control across the project lifecycle


**Quality \& Closeout**


* Enforce build quality and consistency as Nooks scales across sites, reinforcing repeatable standards
* Run internal and external project meetings that keep decisions, accountability, and momentum on track
* Drive closeout — punch lists, final inspections, and handoff to Operations


**What Success Looks Like in This Role**



Within the first year, this person has taken multiple Nooks sites from design through turnover on schedule and on budget, with no surprises that leadership learns about late. Drawing sets move cleanly through SD, DD, and CD because issues are caught and resolved before they reach the field. Contractors and vendors are managed tightly, with RFIs, submittals, and change orders reviewed against both design intent and budget. Construction leadership relies on this person as the single owner of delivery for their projects — knowing the status, the risks, and the path to handoff at any moment. As the playbook matures, each build is more repeatable than the last.


**Cross\-Functional Expectations**



You will work daily with Product on standards and program requirements, with Finance on budget control and change validation, and with IT/Cyber and Operations to ensure each space is built to accreditation and ready for handoff. Externally, you are Nooks' primary point of contact for architects, engineers, consultants, and general contractors — driving their work to Nooks standards rather than simply receiving it. Success in these relationships means deciding quickly with imperfect information and keeping every party aligned on scope, schedule, and budget.


**The Skillset**


**Hard requirements**


* 7–10 years of project management in construction and architecture, with direct ownership of drawings and construction execution
* Demonstrated experience coordinating drawing sets across SD, DD, and CD phases and reviewing for constructability
* Experience managing contractors and vendors, including RFIs, submittals, and change orders, to spec
* Working knowledge of permitting and approvals processes and how to navigate them efficiently
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned
* Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., Procore), Google Workspace, and industry\-standard drawing\-review software


**Preferred**


* Experience in a high\-growth or startup environment, particularly multi\-site or repeatable build programs
* Proximity to a major airport


**Eligibility \& Clearance**



Candidates must be a United States Citizen. An active security clearance is preferred. All candidates must be eligible for and committed to obtaining and maintaining eligibility up to the Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) level as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Public Sector
jobs.description:
This posting is for a new vacancy.


Google utilizes AI tools to assist in assessing candidates in our hiring processes.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:  

  

**In\-office locations: Ottawa, ON, Canada; Toronto, ON, Canada; Montreal, QC, Canada.**  

**Remote location(s): Ontario, CA.**### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, software development, or a related field.
* Experience with architectural design and technical system analysis.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing software or hardware projects from inception to launch.
* Experience in designing and delivering programs to meet contractual requirements and obligations within the public sector environment.
* Candidates must hold or be eligible to obtain a valid Personnel Security Clearance as a condition of employment.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a technical field.
* Experience in a specific domain relevant to the team (e.g., sovereign/air\-gap infrastructure, data and AI, security or distributed systems).
* Experience of program delivery in defence or national security space.
* Strong track record of navigating high\-ambiguity environments and delivering results in a fast\-paced, evolving landscape.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and AI/ML tools to analyze program health and optimize workflows.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Google Public Sector, you will lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish, centred on ensuring we meet our contractual obligations and build enduring trust with our clients. You will work with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your role is essential in bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution, ensuring that our products and infrastructure are built to scale, meet the highest standards of development excellence and ensure that we deliver on the promises made, and that our obligations are met.


At this level, you are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and navigate significant ambiguity. You will not only manage programs but also shape the strategic direction of your area, influencing development roadmaps, maintaining compliance with our commitments and obligations and driving expanded impact across multiple teams. You will lead by example, mentoring junior TPMs and fostering a culture of technical excellence and operational efficiency.


Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose\-built for enterprises. We focus on helping United States public sector institutions accelerate their digital transformations, and we continue to make significant investments and grow our team to meet the complex needs of local, state and federal government and educational institutions.

  

Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Canada: $166000 \- $170000 (CAD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Apply development\-level judgment to review architectures, shape technical specifications, and challenge assumptions to ensure robust scalability.
* Manage milestones, dependencies, and risks across cross\-functional teams, translating high\-level business objectives into actionable, multi\-quarter execution roadmaps.
* Ensure strict adherence to contractual client commitments across all relevant Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statement of Works (SoWs), and order forms, actively identifying and closing delivery gaps.
* Implement modern AI/ML tooling to automate repetitive workflows, enhance data\-driven decision\-making, and boost team productivity.
* Build consensus across development, product, finance, and legal while refining standard program management methodologies to maximize overall velocity and transparency.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Consulting Manager, Healthcare Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Cognizant Consulting:**  

Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice—we’re a global community of 6,000\+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?
  
  

**About the role:**  

As a Consulting Manager, Healthcare Business Transformation, you will make an impact by leading a comprehensive assessment of enterprise Long\-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) operations, identifying opportunities to improve process efficiency, system interoperability, data integrity, and financial performance. You will be a valued member of the Healthcare Consulting team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, LTSS operations teams, product owners, IT teams, architects, data analysts, finance leaders, and executive sponsors.
  
  

**In this role, you will:**  

* Lead end\-to\-end assessment and documentation of LTSS business processes across authorization, claims, provider, member, and financial workflows.
* Analyze interactions between Pega, QNXT, and related healthcare platforms to identify process, integration, and data flow gaps.
* Evaluate authorization\-to\-claims transaction integrity, data mappings, and operational controls to identify root causes of processing issues and financial leakage.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, discovery sessions, and executive presentations to align business and technology teams on findings and recommendations.
* Develop actionable remediation roadmaps, business cases, risk assessments, and transformation strategies that improve operational performance and reduce business risk.


**Work model:**  

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  

**What you need to have to be considered:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, business transformation, program management, or healthcare operations.
* Strong experience with QNXT and healthcare payer platforms, including claims, benefits, enrollments, and authorization workflows.
* Experience working with Pega\-based healthcare workflows, care management, or authorization management processes.
* Proven expertise in healthcare process analysis, stakeholder management, business requirements, and current\-state/future\-state process mapping.
* Experience conducting system integration reviews, data lineage assessments, reconciliation analysis, and business impact evaluations.
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
* Experience creating executive\-level deliverables, recommendations, remediation roadmaps, and transformation strategies.


**These will help you stand out:**  

* Experience supporting Molina Healthcare or other Medicaid and LTSS\-focused healthcare organizations.
* Knowledge of healthcare claims processing, financial workflows, payment integrity, and leakage analysis.
* Experience leading enterprise assessments involving interoperability, data governance, and technology modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with healthcare regulatory requirements, managed care operations, and value\-based care environments.
* Experience with business architecture, process mining, workflow optimization, or healthcare transformation consulting engagements.


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
  
  

**Total Compensation:**  

The annual salary for this position is between $81,450 \- $129,500 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
  
  

**Benefits:**  

Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:
  
* Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
* Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off.
* 401(k) plan and contributions.
* Long\-term/Short\-term Disability.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Want to build the systems that get AWS's largest customers from AI idea to production faster? jobs.title: Intelligence Manager, Global Intelligence Operations Center
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

 **Intelligence Manager, Global Intelligence Operations Center**

  

Dedicated Enterprise Account · Santa Monica, California

 **Location**

  

On\-site — Santa Monica, California

 **Employment type**

  

Full\-time, exempt. Dedicated to one client account.

 **Salary range**

  

$120,000 – $145,000 annually

 **Entity**

  

M1 Global — part of the Specialized family of brands

 **About M1 Global**

  

Since 1994, M1 Global has grown from a local security provider to the trusted security partner of Fortune 500 companies worldwide. We build security programs for complex enterprise environments — from loading docks to data centers, headquarters to event venues — powered by Aurix™, our proprietary automation platform that pairs skilled specialists with proven processes for industry\-leading prevention, detection and reporting. Wherever and however our clients operate, we integrate.

 **Protecting the companies that power the world.**

 **The Role**

  

You own the analytical standard. Every product the Global Intelligence Operations Center publishes to the client carries it — how sources are graded, how fact is separated from assessment, how confidence is stated, and what gets held back. You write that standard, you enforce it through a release gate, and you are answerable for the quality of every product the center publishes, on every shift.

  

The center runs 24/7/365 with watch officers supervising analysts on the floor at a one\-to\-two ratio. You lead those supervisors. You also produce the strategic assessments the watch floor cannot write — the quarterly view of the risk environment across the client's footprint, produced away from the alert queue so it is not written in the gaps between alerts.

  

You are engaged within thirty minutes on any declared incident, at any hour.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Analytical Standards**

* Author and maintain the source validation policy, the confidence lexicon and the analytical writing standard, and publish them so an analyst and a client decision\-maker read the same words the same way.
* Operate the release gate. Decide what is published, what returns for rework and what is held, and be able to defend each call.
* Hold the line on tradecraft under time pressure. A fast product that overstates confidence is a failure.
 **Product Quality and Measurement**

* Own product quality measures including analytical writing quality, source validation compliance, assessment timeliness and release gate first\-pass rate.
* Ensure every product associated with a priority\-one event is reviewed, not sampled.
* Investigate misses to root cause and separate volume, staffing and platform tuning causes.
 **Strategic Production**

* Produce recurring strategic assessments of the risk environment affecting the client's global footprint, written for executive decision\-makers.
* Set the product mix with the client and retire products that no longer earn their place.
* Answer executive requests for information with sourced, defensible assessments inside agreed turnaround times.
 **Analyst Development**

* Lead and develop watch officers, intelligence analysts and the protective intelligence and travel security function.
* Coach on structured analytic technique, bias mitigation, source evaluation and analytical writing — continuously and in writing, not at annual review.
* Participate in quarterly blind calibration against the published rubric and reconcile scoring differences openly.
 **Incident and Crisis Support**

* Assume intelligence coordination authority on a declared incident and produce rolling situation reports at the cadence the client sets.
* Serve as the analytical voice to leadership during a crisis — give decision\-makers the picture they need in the time they have to decide.
* Direct surge analytical capacity when the situation requires it.
* Own the intelligence side of the handoff into physical security operations — what is passed, how fast it is acknowledged and whether it arrives usable. Handoff volume, acknowledgement time and handoff quality are measured and reported monthly.
 **Platform and Tradecraft**

* Own analytical use of the intelligence tool stack, including protective intelligence case management, alerting and mass notification platforms, and open\-source collection tooling.
* Drive alert relevance tuning and false\-positive triage, and evidence platform performance for the client, who holds the vendor relationships.
* Maintain the case record so an assessment does not reset when an analyst leaves.
 **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Eight or more years in intelligence analysis, including three years leading or formally reviewing the work of other analysts.
* **Standard setting:** You have written and published an analytical writing standard, rubric or source grading policy that others were held to. Be prepared to discuss it.
* **Tradecraft:** Working command of structured analytic techniques, cognitive bias mitigation, source evaluation and grading, and open\-source intelligence tradecraft including digital hygiene.
* **Writing:** Proven analytical writing under time pressure, bottom line up front, with confidence and information gaps stated explicitly. A written product sample is required at interview.
* **Domain:** Demonstrable corporate protective intelligence, threat assessment or executive\-facing risk analysis experience. Console or dispatch experience is not a substitute.
* **Platforms:** Proficiency with commercial protective intelligence case management, real\-time alerting and mass notification platforms.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in international relations, security studies, political science, intelligence studies, journalism, criminal justice or a related analytical discipline — or equivalent military or government intelligence experience.
* **Eligibility:** Authorized to work in the United States. Able to pass background, drug and client\-required security screenin

The Subscriber Lifecycle \& Commerce Analytics team is looking for a Data Analyst who will help to measure, understand, and take action to improve our purchasing and payment experience. This team collaborates with stakeholders from business units across The Walt Disney Company to generate insightful, compelling, and strategic analyses. This role will build strong relationships and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Business Operations, and other Analytics teams to ensure the business executes effective experiments around payment processing, fraud prevention, and other commerce domains.

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead the end\-to\-end experimentation lifecycle for commerce experiments including payments and fraud prevention. This includes defining success metrics, determining required sample sizes, and validating randomization.
* Partner closely with business stakeholders (Product, Data Science, Business Operations, etc.) to analyze user behavior, design and evaluate interventions in payment and monetization, and identify ways to maximize subscriber retention.
* Create and maintain operational dashboards in Looker and Tableau to understand performance over time, enable efficient exploratory analysis, and equip partners with self\-service tools.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or other related field.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on analytical work experience with SQL driving strategic analysis to inform product or business decision making.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to apply business strategy to data analysis and recommendations.
* Strong foundational knowledge of applied statistics, causal inference, and experimentation mechanics in technology products.
* Strong proficiency in SQL (especially Snowflake and/or Databricks) for manipulating large data sets, building data pipelines, and interpreting data trends.

* Strong technical analysis skills to investigate issues, analyze causes, quickly develop possible solutions, document changes, and communicate organizational impact.

Rexel, worldwide expert in the professional multichannel distribution of electrical products and services for the energy world, addresses three main markets \- residential, commercial, and industrial. Passionate, dedicated and highly knowledgeable, our people are instrumental in bringing innovative electrification solutions to the field and making energy transition happen. We believe in bringing positive energy to everything we do.


This Company operates through a network of over 1,900 branches in 19 countries, with more than 27,000 employees. The Group’s sales were €19\.2 billion in 2024\.


Join Rexel’s IT \& Digital Team – Driving Innovation with Axelerate 28 :

jobs.description:
Fondé en 1969, Cegedim est un Groupe innovant de technologies et de services spécialisé dans la gestion des flux numériques de l’écosystème santé et BtoB, ainsi que dans la conception de logiciels métier destinés aux professionnels de santé et de l’assurance. Cegedim compte près de 6 500 collaborateurs dans plus de 10 pays et a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 649,2 millions d’euros en 2025\.


Pour en savoir plus : www.cegedim.fr


Et suivez Cegedim sur Twitter : @CegedimGroup, LinkedIn et Facebook.

**Contexte :**


L'activité Flux Santé de Cegedim, éditeur de logiciels de référence dans le secteur de la santé, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans l’ensemble de l’écosystème de santé – établissements, industriels, et professionnels de santé – dans leur transformation digitale.


Au cœur de cette mission, Cegedim opère et sécurise des flux d'informations critiques, grâce à une expertise unique en interopérabilité, gestion des données de santé et en processus métiers.


Au sein de notre équipe Marketing Santé, vous jouerez un rôle clé en amont de l'action commerciale : éclairer les décisions par la donnée.

 **Mission générale**

  



Vous êtes **ingénieur avec une appétence pour le commerce** et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement où la donnée sert directement la stratégie commerciale. Votre rôle : transformer les données clients en **insights actionnables**, fournir aux commerciaux des **dossiers de rendez\-vous à forte valeur ajoutée**, et contribuer à la **communication opérationnelle** via des contenus simples orientés business.

**Responsabilités principales**

  



* **Analyse avancée des données clients**— extraction, nettoyage, structuration et modélisation des données issues du CRM, bases de données internes, et données externes
* **Préparation de l'action commerciale** — synthèse des comportements clients, scoring, historique, opportunités, KPIs clés, fiches d'aide à la vente transmises aux équipes commerciales
* **Restitution et dataviz** — conception de tableaux de bord et de reportings (Power BI, Excel…) pour suivre les indicateurs marketing et partager les insights avec les équipes.
* **Veille analytique**— benchmark des pratiques data, exploration de nouveaux indicateurs, outils ou méthodes.
* **Mise en forme de supports commerciaux**: présentations, fiches produits, cas clients.
* **Production de contenus simples** pour les réseaux sociaux : posts, visuels, mini\-vidéos orientées business.

  

Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur (Bac\+3 à Bac\+5\) avec spécialisation data, informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou systèmes d’information, vous recherchez une alternance d'un à deux ans.

  


* **Compétences data** : maîtrise d'Excel, premières expériences en SQL et sur un outil de dataviz (Power BI, Tableau…) ; des notions de Python ou R sont un plus.
* **Esprit d'analyse** : vous aimez faire parler les chiffres et transformer la donnée brute en recommandations actionnables
* **Sens business** : curieux(se) des enjeux commerciaux et marketing, vous comprenez les enjeux liés à la donnée, et que votre analyse sert la performance des équipes de vente.
* **Qualités relationnelles** : rigueur, autonomie et capacité à vulgariser vos résultats auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques. Aisance relationnelle avec les équipes commerciales comme les équipes techniques des opérations et de la R\&D


Un intérêt pour le secteur de la santé et ses enjeux (réglementation, e\-santé, données de santé) sera particulièrement apprécié.


 Nous rejoindre en alternance, c'est aussi rejoindre notre Communauté Alternants !


Chez nous, 3 événements par an sont organisés pour se former, créer des liens forts entre alternants.


Et ce n'est que le début : d'autres projets sont à venir.


Venez apprendre, partager et grandir avec nous !


Découvrez les témoignages de nos étudiants :


Nos alternants ont la parole \- Rayane, Consultant Technique


Nos alternants ont la parole \- Sandra, Chargée de Communication

Dans le cadre de la démarche de numérique responsable, les livrables attendus doivent respecter les principes d?éco\-conception et d?accessibilité numérique applicables, avec prise en compte des référentiels et bonnes pratiques mentionnés dans le document source.

**Compétences fonctionnelles :**  

? expérience dans une organisation appliquant des frameworks Agile (Scrum, SAFe) appréciée
  
  

**Compétences techniques :**  

? maîtrise avancée de Power Query et des dataflow Gen1
  
**? maîtrise des fondamentaux de la Data Engineering :** tables de faits et dimensions, cardinalité, architecture médaillon
  
**? maîtrise de la suite Power BI :** data visualisation, DAX, modèles de données, administration de Power BI Services
  
? maîtrise avancée d?Excel
  
**? connaissance des outils de la Power Platform :** Power Automate et Power Apps
  
? connaissance de Dataiku appréciée
  
  

**Compétences relationnelles et qualités personnelles :**  

? capacité d?écoute
  
? esprit de synthèse
  
? capacité d?analyse
  
? souplesse / agilité

jobs.title: Project Manager - Design and Construction
jobs.description:
**ABOUT NOOKS**



Nooks is pioneering Classified\-Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission\-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We're growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

**About the Role**



You will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Nooks' physical spaces — from early design coordination through construction and handoff to Operations. This role exists because building accredited classified environments at speed and at scale requires a single owner who can hold scope, schedule, and budget across every site, translate Nooks' product standards into buildable solutions, and keep architects, engineers, and general contractors moving toward handoff. You will report into Nooks' Construction function within Product as an individual contributor, working from a remote or hybrid base with travel of up to 50% to project sites. In this role, you are an individual contributor as part of the Nooks Construction Team, under the VP of Product. You will work on a remote or hybrid basis with travel to project sites up to 50% of the time.



This is a builder role. While you'll have clearly defined ownership areas, priorities shift quickly in a fast\-moving, build\-heavy environment, and the right person steps into whatever the project needs — making decisions with imperfect information, improving the process as they go, and treating every build as a chance to make the next one more repeatable.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Design Coordination \& Documentation**


* Coordinate the full drawing process across schematic design, design development, and construction document (SD, DD, CD) phases, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to Nooks standards
* Partner with Product Security to translate program and accreditation requirements into buildable, repeatable solutions
* Review drawing sets with architects and engineers to resolve constructability issues before they reach the field


**Construction Execution**


* Oversee general contractors and vendors through construction, owning schedule tracking, site coordination, and issue resolution
* Review requests for information (RFIs), submittals, and change orders against design intent and budget before approval
* Lead permitting and approvals, managing submissions and comment responses to protect the schedule


**Project Controls \& Delivery**


* Own each project from early design through turnover, holding scope, schedule, and budget at every stage
* Track milestones and surface risks early, driving mitigation before they affect delivery
* Partner with Finance to monitor budgets, validate changes, and maintain financial control across the project lifecycle


**Quality \& Closeout**


* Enforce build quality and consistency as Nooks scales across sites, reinforcing repeatable standards
* Run internal and external project meetings that keep decisions, accountability, and momentum on track
* Drive closeout — punch lists, final inspections, and handoff to Operations


**What Success Looks Like in This Role**



Within the first year, this person has taken multiple Nooks sites from design through turnover on schedule and on budget, with no surprises that leadership learns about late. Drawing sets move cleanly through SD, DD, and CD because issues are caught and resolved before they reach the field. Contractors and vendors are managed tightly, with RFIs, submittals, and change orders reviewed against both design intent and budget. Construction leadership relies on this person as the single owner of delivery for their projects — knowing the status, the risks, and the path to handoff at any moment. As the playbook matures, each build is more repeatable than the last.


**Cross\-Functional Expectations**



You will work daily with Product on standards and program requirements, with Finance on budget control and change validation, and with IT/Cyber and Operations to ensure each space is built to accreditation and ready for handoff. Externally, you are Nooks' primary point of contact for architects, engineers, consultants, and general contractors — driving their work to Nooks standards rather than simply receiving it. Success in these relationships means deciding quickly with imperfect information and keeping every party aligned on scope, schedule, and budget.


**The Skillset**


**Hard requirements**


* 7–10 years of project management in construction and architecture, with direct ownership of drawings and construction execution
* Demonstrated experience coordinating drawing sets across SD, DD, and CD phases and reviewing for constructability
* Experience managing contractors and vendors, including RFIs, submittals, and change orders, to spec
* Working knowledge of permitting and approvals processes and how to navigate them efficiently
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned
* Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., Procore), Google Workspace, and industry\-standard drawing\-review software


**Preferred**


* Experience in a high\-growth or startup environment, particularly multi\-site or repeatable build programs
* Proximity to a major airport


**Eligibility \& Clearance**



Candidates must be a United States Citizen. An active security clearance is preferred. All candidates must be eligible for and committed to obtaining and maintaining eligibility up to the Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) level as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Data & AI GTM
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Want to build the systems that get AWS's largest customers from AI idea to production faster? We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the mechanisms that connect customers to expert AI builder teams and then turn what those teams deliver into reusable assets that help accelerate all AWS customers.  

  

You'll operate at the center of a flywheel: customers come in with complex AI challenges, you route them to the right expertise or solution, those engagements produce proven patterns and customer signals, and you package those learnings so the next customer doesn't need high\-touch support at all. If you love designing systems that start hands\-on and end self\-service, this role is for you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own intake, triage, and routing of customer Data \& AI engagement requests across multiple builder teams (specialists, professional services, prototyping labs, and partners)
* Define and enforce SLAs for triage, assignment, and delivery across all participating builder teams; report on adherence and escalate blockers
* Automate coordination workflows that today take days of back\-and\-forth, reducing cycle time and removing dependency on individual heroics
* Work across geographies and organizations to keep the mechanism running smoothly and improving continuously
* Partner with builder team leaders to maintain balanced workload distribution and clear escalation paths
* Capture engagement deliverables and package them into reusable architectures, code, and playbooks that customers can grab off the shelf to get to production
* Build the distribution mechanism that makes reusable assets discoverable and accessible to field sellers and customers at the right moment in their journey
* Analyze engagement data to identify trends in customer needs, builder team capacity, and routing quality; use findings to inform GTM strategy and investment decisions

  

About the team  

Our team drives the go\-to\-market strategy and execution for AWS's data and AI services, working directly with field sellers and partners worldwide to help customers adopt and succeed. You'll collaborate with Technical Business Developers and Program Managers who each own different programs and domains; together, you connect customers to the right expertise, build reusable assets from successful engagements, and design automation that makes the next customer's path to production faster. We're charting the future of fully agentic channels that deliver assistance to customers at scale, and our mission is to make it faster and easier for every customer to get from AI ambition to production workload.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large\-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.title: Trade & Cash Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Stanford Management Company (SMC), the University’s investment office, invests the Merged Pool, which includes substantially all of the University’s investable endowment assets. The investment portfolio is designed with the dual goals of preserving the purchasing power of the Endowment for future generations of Stanford students and scholars and enabling a robust annual disbursement to the University’s operating budget. SMC primarily relies on carefully chosen external partners to select individual securities, allowing Stanford to benefit from specialized knowledge in asset classes that reward superior active management.  



SMC is seeking an organized and detail\-oriented Trade \& Cash Operations Analyst who will report to the Manager, Trade \& Cash Operations. This position is critical for facilitating securities transactions and cash movements while providing key investment information to the SMC investment team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate high productivity, meticulous attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills, with proven experience in equity and fixed income security settlement and cash flow management.  



**Duties Unique to This Role:**

* Provide constituents with relevant, accurate, and consistent information for investment oversight and decision making.
* Produce cash forecast for daily asset allocation reporting, explaining key fluctuations and changes for use by the Investment Team.
* Facilitate securities transactions, complex securities, settlements, and reconciliations.
* Monitor all investment approvals and activity, accurately record activity, and serve as the primary interface with internal and external parties.

*\*Other duties may also be assigned*

The expected pay range for this position is is $92,000 \- $120,000 per annum.


  
**Core Duties** :


* Calculate performance and perform structured analysis of results for marketable and non\-marketable investments.
* Provide effective, relevant, and focused financial management reports and dashboards. Identify and investigate discrepancies and underlying issues in reporting; recognize exceptions, develop solutions that may require policy changes or development of new reports and/or dashboards.
* Provide portfolio and asset allocation reporting. Run, maintain, reconcile, review, combine, analyze and validate financial data sets, utilizing financial databases and key financial information from multiple systems including Solovis, Bloomberg, and others.
* Prepare fund movements for authorization including internal cash transfers, wire set\-up, and investment funding. Resolve issues, recognize exceptions and recommend solutions.
* Process, record, and perform recurring investment accounting activities and maintain integrity of accounting and investment data for Merged Pool and School \& Department Funds investments.
* Collect data and perform research on details of transactions. Ensure work complies with complex internal policies and external regulations which may require interpretation.
* Onboard new investments, ensuring that all investments are accurately set up in custodian’s and Stanford’s systems. Deposit key investment manager materials on internal data storage system.
* Prepare, track, and process investment valuations, transactions, and corporate actions. Ensure related documentation is completed and archived. Prepare reconciliations to custodian records.
* Work as a member of a project team and contribute to change management strategy through communication and collaboration with others.
* Serve as a first line resource to brokers and custodian bank; identify and resolve issues.
* Interface with key internal and external stakeholders, including exhibiting a strong customer service orientation.

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Associate’s degree or combination of education and work experience.


Bachelor’s degree and two years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant work experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Experience with a variety of investment types (public and private).
* Understanding of and ability to apply accounting skills and concepts. Knowledge of and experience with accounting systems.
* Proficiency in business applications, such as Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel.
* Experience in financial modeling and business intelligence applications to produce analysis and presentations.
* High degree of accuracy, strong attention to detail, and efficient execution of responsibilities
* Robust organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload, set deadlines independently, and complete tasks in a timely and efficient manner.
* Strong communication skills, including ability to prepare materials for and clearly and effectively communicate information to internal and external audiences, client groups, and management.

Prosegur’s Global Risk Services (GRS) operates Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) services for our clients as a dedicated, managed service. This position is part of a dedicated, embedded team supporting an multinational client in the medical technology sector. This high\-performing team of Risk Intelligence Analysts is responsible for monitoring threats to travelers, intaking and assessing intelligence alerts, providing support for the crisis management program, and conducting protective intelligence monitoring to assist the Executive Protection (EP) team on a 24x7x365 basis. This intelligence\-focused GSOC works closely with the client’s Global Security staff to provide custom intelligence products to support the client’s needs.


The **Risk Intelligence Analyst** is a specialized, leadership role within the GSOC. This analyst provides focused intelligence and threat monitoring in direct support of EP teams. While sharing the core duties of the Risk Intelligence Analyst, this role emphasizes proactive identification, analysis, and communication of threats impacting executives, their families, and company operations. Responsibilities include drafting executive\-level security overviews for international travel and events, monitoring and reporting on executive travel, conducting deep social media monitoring to identify and escalate threats, engaging with third\-party security providers to provide intelligence support during EP operations, as well as conducting research and leveraging behavioral threat analysis techniques to assess risks posed by identified Persons of Interest (POIs).

**Responsibilities**


The main responsibilities of the EP Intelligence Analyst include:

* Monitor global events and provide real\-time intelligence and overwatch of client operations, with **priority focus on executive protection assignments, executive travel, residences, and corporate facilities**.
* Fuse internal and external intelligence sources to research, analyze, and aggregate threat data specifically related to executive movements, public appearances, and exposure.
* Conduct protective intelligence assessments to identify individuals, groups, or movements posing potential threats to executives leveraging both research skills and behavioral threat analysis techniques
* Deliver timely alerts and specialized threat advisories tailored to executive protection teams.
* Support advance planning for executive travel and events by providing country, regional, and event\-specific risk intelligence.
* Provide **direct intelligence support to executive protection agents and coordinate with both in\-house and third\-party EP teams**, ensuring they have actionable threat assessments before and real\-time situational awareness during missions.
* Utilize social media monitoring, OSINT, and specialized protective intelligence tools to track potential hostile surveillance, protests, threats, or other emerging risks to executives and company operations.
* Monitor, report on, and provide situational awareness on senior executive travewl including compiling upcoming travel reports, daily executive travel briefings, etc.
* Conduct ad\-hoc briefings for senior leadership and EP agents on unfolding events impacting executives.
* Develop specialized protective intelligence products, such as **Executive Threat Profiles, Event Risk Assessments, and Protective Travel Advisories**.
* Coordinate with GSOC peers to ensure alignment on global incident response, escalation, and dispatch of protective services. Provide front\-line, dotted\-line leadership over the GSOC by providing training and infusing protective intelligence capabilities across the wider team.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and back\-up to the GSOC Program Manager, as needed.
* Liaise directly with company EP leadership and internal stakeholders, including Corporate Aviation, HR, Legal, and other stakeholders.
* Support weekly and quarterly reporting with sections dedicated to executive protection threat trends.
* Maintain, update, and monitor a comprehensive POI database via the client’s internal case management system (Ontic); ensure appropriate investigative capabilities are being leveraged effectively and active alerting thresholds are in place.

jobs.title: AV Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

The Field Implementation Manager (FIM) is a senior field leadership and technical execution
  
governance role within Diversified’s Technical Operations (Tech Ops) organization. This position
  
serves as the highest field\-facing execution authority during the implementation phase of projects
  
and is accountable for ensuring that complex broadcast, media, experiential AV, and enterprise AV
  
systems are executed safely, accurately, efficiently, and in full alignment with engineering intent,
  
project schedules, and Diversified standards.
  
  

The FIM plays a critical role before installation begins by partnering with the Account Executive during
  
early site walks and pre\-implementation assessments to evaluate site conditions, access,
  
infrastructure readiness, constructability, sequencing constraints, and unique environmental
  
considerations. The FIM is responsible for documenting and clearly communicating these findings
  
through written assessments, photographs, diagrams, and annotated drawings as required, ensuring
  
Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, and Operations teams have a shared and accurate
  
understanding of the installation environment.
  
  

During execution, the FIM operates above Installation Site Supervisors and Lead Technicians,
  
providing multi\-site execution governance, technical escalation authority, and field leadership across
  
active projects. The FIM ensures that systems are not only installed correctly, but that what was
  
designed, fabricated, kitted, shipped, and delivered matches specification exactly, with zero\-defect
  
expectations applied to materials readiness, logistics coordination, and commissioning
  
preparedness.
  
  

The Field Implementation Manager works in close collaboration with Tech Ops Project Managers,
  
Engineering (COE), Fabrication Services, Operations, Logistics \& Compliance, and Supply Chain to
  
ensure a seamless transition from design through fabrication, kitting, delivery, installation, and
  
commissioning. As a highly visible, customer\-facing leader, the FIM must demonstrate
  
professionalism, composure, and technical clarity, including the ability to answer challenging
  
technical questions or translate complex systems into clear, client\-understandable terms with
  
patience and confidence.
  
  

The Field Implementation Manager operates as the technical execution authority within the Tech Ops
  
delivery framework, ensuring that engineering design intent is translated into disciplined,
  
predictable, and high\-quality field implementation. In doing so, the role protects system integrity,
  
reinforces installation discipline across multiple projects, and ensures that the transition from
  
design and fabrication to field implementation occurs with precision and consistency.
  
Success in this role directly impacts execution quality, schedule reliability, client confidence, and
  
Diversified’s reputation for delivering complex systems with discipline, precision, and excellence.
  
  

**The Field Implementation Manager exists to ensure that:**  

* Engineering intent is executed without compromise
* Site conditions and constraints are accurately understood and communicated early
* Fabricated systems are built, kitted, delivered, and installed exactly as specified
* Field execution operates with consistency, safety, and predictability
* Client confidence is reinforced through informed, calm, and professional leadership


**What You’ll Do:**  

Pre\-Implementation Site Assessment \& Project Readiness
  
* Conduct initial site walks with the Account Executive to assess scope, scale, access, infrastructure readiness, and environmental constraints
* Identify site\-specific risks impacting installation sequencing, logistics, safety, or cost
* Document site conditions using written assessments, photographs, sketches, and diagrams as required
* Communicate site findings clearly to Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication Services, and Operations teams
* Support site surveys for project planning and sales support e•orts


Field Execution Governance \& Quality Oversight
  
* Provide senior oversight across active job sites within the assigned region
* Serve as the first point of escalation for field execution, quality, safety, or technical issues
* Inspect and verify installation quality, workmanship standards, and adherence to engineering designs
* Confirm installed systems match approved designs, specifications, and kitting documentation
* Verify commissioning readiness prior to system turn\-up


Fabrication, Kitting \& Logistics Coordination
  
* Maintain close collaboration with Fabrication Services and fabrication technicians to ensure systems are built exactly as designed
* Ensure racks and systems are kitted in a zero\-defect manner, including hardware, cabling, labeling, documentation, and accessories
* Coordinate with Operations, Logistics \& Compliance and Supply Chain for timely, safe, and accurate delivery of kitted systems to job sites
* Verify material completeness and readiness prior to site installation activities
* Escalate fabrication or logistics discrepancies immediately to prevent downstream execution risk
