About Altais:


At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose\-built tools, and a team\-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.


Altais includes a network of physician\-led organizations across California, including Brown \& Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast\-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose\-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.


The Provider Data Management Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing, maintaining, and validating provider data with a focus on credentialing and health plan provider roster creation. This role ensures provider information is accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned across internal systems, payer platforms, and regulatory submissions. The analyst supports credentialing operations, roster production, data quality monitoring, audits, and process improvement initiatives.

**You will focus on:**


Provider Data Analysis and Quality

* Analyze provider data to identify inaccuracies, missing information, duplicates, and inconsistencies.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance across multiple systems.
* Review provider demographic, specialty, affiliation, licensure, credentialing, and participation information.
* Track data\-quality trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain data standards, definitions, procedures, and documentation.

Credentialing Data Management

* Support provider onboarding, recredentialing, updates, and terminations.
* Review credentialing data for completeness and alignment with organizational policies.
* Validate licenses, certifications, specialties, malpractice coverage, affiliations, and other credentialing elements.
* Identify credential expirations, missing documentation, and records requiring remediation.
* Partner with credentialing teams to improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Support compliance with applicable state requirements, CMS guidance, and accreditation standards.

Health Plan Provider Roster Creation and Validation

* Create and maintain provider rosters for submission to health plans and other external partners.
* Extract, transform, format, and validate provider data according to payer\-specific requirements.

* Confirm roster accuracy for demographics, specialties, products, locations, affiliations, provider identifiers, and participation status.
* Perform pre\-submission quality checks and resolve exceptions before delivery.
* Reconcile submitted rosters with source systems and health plan feedback.
* Coordinate corrections, resubmissions, and status updates within established turnaround times.
* Maintain roster templates, submission schedules, version controls, and applicable payer documentation.


Reporting and Analytics

* Develop recurring and ad hoc reports related to credentialing status, roster accuracy, data completeness, and operational performance.
* Monitor key performance indicators, such as data error rates, roster turnaround time, rejected records, and credentialing timeliness.
* Use Excel, SQL, Power BI, or other analytical tools to transform data into actionable insights.
* Document analytical methods, assumptions, exceptions, and findings.
* Present results and recommendations to business partners and leadership.

Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Serve as a subject matter expert for credentialing data and roster processes.
* Communicate data issues, business impacts, and recommended resolutions clearly.
* Support testing and validation for system enhancements, integrations, and process changes.
* Assist with internal, health plan, and regulatory audits.

Process Improvement and Governance

* Identify opportunities to streamline roster creation, validation, and reconciliation processes.
* Support automation and workflow\-improvement initiatives.
* Establish repeatable controls for data accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
* Maintain version\-controlled process documentation and standard operating procedures.
* Promote consistent data governance practices across provider data workflows.
**The Skills, Experience \& Education You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration, Data Analytics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Three or more years of experience in healthcare data analysis, provider data management, credentialing, provider enrollment, or a related discipline.
* Experience working with provider data elements, including NPI, taxonomy, licensure, specialties, practice locations, and health plan participation.
* Experience creating, validating, and submitting provider rosters.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, filtering, and data reconciliation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage competing deadlines.

The Base Salary for this position is **$75,000 \- $90,000/year**

  

In addition, we provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs.

* Excellent medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 401k savings plan with a company match
* Flexible time off and 9 Paid Holidays

jobs.title: Product Strategy and Operations Analyst, Google Education
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.

Experience working with and analyzing data.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience gathering and analyzing data to uncover insights.
* Experience managing complex systems, cross\-functional stakeholder groups, and large\-scale change management initiatives.
* Strong problem solving skills, combined with outstanding business judgment, communication, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



The Education team's mission is to transform learning and teaching at scale. We do this by helping K\-12 and higher education institutions around the world bring the best of Google tools and technology to their organizations. We've made significant headway on this journey. With AI, the potential for technology to enhance education is greater than ever.


The Strategy and Operations team will help shape the cross\-Google narrative for Google Education, translating our high\-level outlook into an operational reality, ensuring our business is run effectively. In this role, you will have the defining opportunity to transform teaching and learning for students globally. By harnessing learning science and the breakthrough capabilities being developed across Google, you will shape the future of education.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $126000 \- $180000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish Key Performance Indicators and timelines for each project, regular metrics reporting, that tie back to strategic goals, and post\-implementation impact analysis.
* Drive end\-to\-end operational aptitude to ensure flawless execution of the highest\-priority goals.
* Support annual planning activities for the Edu portfolio.
* Contribute on strategic projects that are operationally intensive and cross\-functional to ensure there is structure and timely delivery of project goals.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* 5 or more years of progressive business systems or ERP experience, including strong hands\-on experience administering and supporting NetSuite in a complex business environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. NetSuite certifications are preferred; however, strong practical NetSuite experience and demonstrated capability are considered more important

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Customer Success Program Manager (M3\) owns the end\-to\-end partner operating model, launch execution, customer health management system, performance framework, governance layer, and scale readiness for a financial solutions CSM initiative. The M3 serves as the primary operational lead managing executive client alignment, quality architecture, SLA compliance, and cross\-functional escalation models. During initial program launch phases, the M3 also carries direct frontline team management and quality oversight responsibilities prior to deploying dedicated frontline manager layers.


Salary: $140\-150k \+15% Performance Bonus

 **Core Responsibilities**

* **Program Governance \& Operating Model:** Establish and operate the partner\-scale management structure, QA process, coaching framework, reporting cadence, governance layer, and cross\-functional escalation protocols.
* **Scorecard \& Analytics Architecture:** Translate client scorecards into portfolio heat maps, health signals, risk and opportunity thresholds, success plan standards, engagement triggers, dashboards, and executive business reviews.
* **Launch \& Ramp Execution:** Own launch readiness across recruiting funnel alignment, candidate assessment workflows, dedicated trainer integration, systems access provisioning, and AI role\-play readiness gates.
* **Direct Launch Leadership:** Provide direct team management, coaching, interaction reviews, corrective action, and escalation support during initial program launch phases before frontline managers are deployed.
* **Executive Client Alignment \& SLAs:** Partner with client enterprise stakeholders to align on written metric definitions, numerical targets, data sources, attribution rules, authority boundaries, and formal SLA commencement.
* **Capacity \& Portfolio Optimization:** Continually optimize staffing allocation, management ratios, portfolio distribution (dedicated vs. pooled coverage models), training reinforcement, and workflow routing based on operating data.
* **Operational Reviews \& Improvement:** Lead weekly operating reviews, monthly business reviews, root\-cause analyses on customer churn/adoption friction, and documented continuous improvement plans.

 **Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Executive CS Leadership:** Minimum of 7 to 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience building, scaling, and managing customer success, account management, renewal, or commercially accountable enterprise organizations.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep background in payments processing, merchant services, banking, lending, fintech, money movement, or financial software environments preferred, but not required
* **Performance Architecture Mastery:** Strong command of customer health frameworks, interaction quality systems, engagement automation tools, and executive scorecard reporting.
* **Cross\-Functional Navigation:** Demonstrated ability to collaborate and operationalize workflows across Customer Success, Sales, Support, Product, Risk Operations, Payments Operations, Billing, Compliance, Security, and enterprise executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Enterprise Managed Services Leadership:** Track record building and operating outsourced or partner delivery models for Fortune 500 technology clients.
* **Advanced Platform Familiarity:** Hands\-on familiarity with candidate screening frameworks, conversation intelligence platforms, and AI\-driven role\-play readiness platforms.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Ramp \& Scale Execution:** On\-time cohort recruitment, assessment throughput, AI readiness pass rates, system access provisioning, and time to live contact.
* **Program Commercial Outcomes:** Program\-wide activation, payment volume expansion, customer retention, and qualified cross\-sell lead generation.
* **Quality \& Operational Rigor:** Program\-wide quality scores, CRM documentation compliance, case routing accuracy across operational teams, escalation resolution, and cost\-to\-serve management.
* **Governance \& SLA Performance:** Executive business review effectiveness, SLA compliance, risk mitigation execution, and scale readiness across successive cohorts.

Koniag Professional Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Business Analyst to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is remote.
  
  

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.
  
  

Koniag Professional Services, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support enterprise technology initiatives within a dynamic federal IT environment. This role supports the development and sustainment of SharePoint Online and Microsoft Power Platform solutions, serving as a critical liaison between business stakeholders, leadership, and technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented and analytically driven professional with a strong foundation in business analysis, agile delivery, and operational sustainment who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
  
  

The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting enterprise technology initiatives with requirements analysis, business analysis, enabling agile delivery processes, and supporting operational sustainment efforts. This individual serves as a liaison between business stakeholders, leadership, and technical teams to ensure business requirements are accurately documented, prioritized, and implemented throughout the full delivery lifecycle.

**Preferred:**  

* Prior experience supporting federal government IT programs or contracts.
* Experience working within SharePoint Online development and sustainment environments.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**  

* Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the ability to clearly articulate complex business and technical information to diverse audiences including senior leadership, technical developers, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the demonstrated ability to evaluate business processes, identify gaps and risks, and develop well\-structured, actionable requirements.

new_jobs.title: Divisional Sales Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation’s largest and fastest\-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.
  
**More information is available on the company's website at:** www.alliant.com.
  
  

SUMMARY
  
  

Responsible for supporting the accuracy and integrity of Salesforce opportunity data and its alignment with Finance processes. Key responsibilities include reviewing and validating opportunity data, identifying and resolving discrepancies, partnering with Sales and Finance stakeholders, supporting revenue reporting and recognition processes, and driving data quality and process improvements.
  
  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Perform regular reviews and audits of Salesfoce data opportunities to identify incomplete, inaccurate, inconsistent, or potentially erroneous information, including opportunity stage, effective date, revenue amount, booking structure, and other key financial and operational fields.
  
  

Research and investigate opportunity discrepancies, work directly with Sales and other business users to determine the appropriate resolution, and follow up to ensure required corrections are completed timely.
  
  

Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to resolve opportunity\-related issues and ensure Salesforce data appropriately supports revenue reporting, revenue recognition, and other downstream financial processes.
  
  

Support month\-end and quarter\-end processes by reviewing opportunity information for completeness and accuracy and helping resolve discrepancies that could impact financial reporting or the timing and accuracy of revenue recognition.
  
  

Escalate potential revenue recognition, accounting, or system\-related issues to the appropriate Finance, Accounting, Salesforce, or IT teams for review and resolution.
  
  

Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor opportunity accuracy, exceptions, outstanding items, and recurring data\-quality issues.
  
  

Monitor recurring errors and trends, recommend process improvements, and help establish controls and procedures that improve Salesforce data quality and reduce recurring issues.
  
  

Serve as a business\-facing Salesforce resource within Finance by communicating required corrections, providing guidance on opportunity management and data\-entry practices, and helping users understand how Salesforce data impacts downstream Finance processes.
  
  

QUALIFICATIONS
  
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  
  

Three (3\) or more years experience in Sales Operations, Finance Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related role
  
  

Experience working within a Finance, Accounting, Sales Operations, or Revenue Operations organization.
  
  

SKILLS
  
  

Hands\-on experience working with Salesforce including creating or working with Salesforce reports and dashboards
  
  

Knowledge of reconciling Salesforce information against contracts, orders, or financial systems
  
  

Knowledge of revenue recognition, financial reporting, billing, or month\-end/quarter\-end close processes
  
  

Strong understanding of Salesforce opportunities and the sales opportunity lifecycle
  
  

Strong experience reviewing, auditing, or maintaining business data for accuracy and completeness
  
  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
  
  

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with Sales and Finance stakeholders
  
  

Strong comfortability working with reports, dashboards, spreadsheets, and large datasets
  
  

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or similar spreadsheet tools
  
  

Ability to investigate discrepancies and work across teams to drive issues through resolution
  
  

Ability to manage multiple issues and follow\-ups while meeting Finance deadlines

\#LI\-RF1
  
  

We are proud to provide comprehensive, high quality employee programs to meet employees' needs now and in the future, including a very competitive financial package. We encourage you to explore what we have to offer.
  
  

For immediate consideration for this position, please click on the "Apply" button.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on their qualifications and ability without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, age, genetic information, or status as a protected veteran, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including California law.

new_jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  

  

Leading programs at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Program Manager, you'll be responsible for the strategy and execution of initiatives that directly impact how riders, earners, and merchants move through the Uber ecosystem. You'll navigate ambiguity and tackle complex operational challenges to drive real\-world impact.  

  

This role requires a mindset that thrives in challenging situations, balancing technical rigor with a deep obsession for the customer journey. You'll need to influence stakeholders and align diverse teams without relying on control, turning complexity into clarity at a global scale. If you are motivated by the chance to shape the future of real\-world movement through structured, data\-backed execution, this is where you'll make your mark.  

  

Rate of Pay: $131,000 to $160,000 per Year  

  

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.
  

  

**What you'll do*** Define and implement agent\-customer communication standards.
* Help define quality for user\-facing support bots.
* Conversational Designer for Uber Customer Support.
* Work with Product and Engineering to update the Response Generation prompt.
* Evaluate the performance of our agent interactions at scale.
* Optimize support resolution steps for interaction efficiency.
* Work with engineering teams to optimize how knowledge is used within a customer\-support conversation.
* Design prompt improvements for chatbots powered by LLMs.
* Develop, own, and implement short \& long\-term strategies for agent responses in support interactions.
* Work with our Metadata team to improve intent identification.
* Continuously enhance all agent\-response products to ensure improvement to key metrics \& user efficacy.
* Coordinate strategic projects between GDX, CO, and Global Content.
* May telecommute.

**Basic Qualifications*** Employer will accept a Master's degree in Conversational Design, Business, Project Management, Information and Knowledge Strategy, or related field and 3 years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
* Position requires:
	+ Prompt engineering and optimization for LLMs to optimize responses, design structured task flows, and improve model accuracy and efficiency in dynamic contexts;
	+ Applying large language models (LLMs) to extract insights, automate processes, and generate high\-quality natural language outputs for business or technical use cases;
	+ Stakeholder management skills, including in delivering change management projects to launch new enterprise\-wide tools or systems;
	+ Building retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) chatbots with a vector database, similarity search\-based reranking and retrieval, and response generation for combining proprietary data sources with generative AI models that ensures factual and contextually grounded outputs;
	+ Model fine\-tuning for customizing pre\-trained LLMs on domain\-specific datasets, improving performance on targeted tasks such as Q\&A through at least one of the following: HuggingFace's API, OpenAI's API;
	+ Implementing Python code for data analysis, automation, API integration, and machine learning pipeline development, including libraries like Pandas, NLTK, Scikit\-learn, or PyTorch, and utilizing cloud environments like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for deploying and managing machine learning models, orchestrating data workflows, and scaling compute resources efficiently;
	+ Qualitative analysis of text data, including thematic analysis and sentiment analysis to interpret customer feedback, identify emerging issues, and inform product, marketing, or support strategies;
	+ Designing a knowledge management strategy, roadmap, and implementation framework to ensure that stakeholders can share and access the needed information and knowledge at the right time;
	+ Designing a continuous improvement process through retrospectives, lessons learned capturing, and cycles of feedback integration;
	+ Information Architecture for maintaining metadata, tagging, findability, and knowledge retrieval systems;  
	
	Information organization for organizing, structuring, and maintaining high\-quality documentation and knowledge assets;
	+ Understanding of knowledge base content curation and best practices, including background in content creation and curation, copy\-editing and style guidelines that inform conversational design.

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

**Position Purpose:**


This role is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end implementation of technology solutions supporting Care Management, translating business and clinical requirements into scalable, well\-governed system deployments. The Implementation Manager drives delivery from design through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization, partnering across clinical, operational, and IT teams to ensure new capabilities are configured, tested, and adopted successfully.

### **Key Details:**

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment\-based visa types H\-1B, L\-1, O\-1, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, or CPT.


This is a remote position within the United States.

* Own the end\-to\-end execution of technology implementation initiatives by managing scope, timeline, stakeholder alignment, and delivery across cross\-functional teams so projects move from requirements through configuration, testing, and go\-live with the discipline needed to build executive confidence and secure investment for scale.
* Serve as the operational backbone of the implementation program — establishing governance structures, project frameworks, and performance measurement criteria that allow the organization to roll out new systems and workflows in a controlled, low\-risk manner and make evidence\-based decisions about configuration, phased rollout, and long\-term support.
* Translate implementation results into enterprise decisions — synthesizing clinical outcomes, operational performance data, and frontline feedback into clear, executive\-ready reporting that gives leadership the insight needed to prioritize technology investments, manage organizational risk, and build a credible, phased path to full\-scale adoption.

* Manage system configuration, workflow design, and integration activities in partnership with IT and vendor teams, applying enterprise frameworks to identify repeatable, high\-leverage implementation approaches.
* Exercise expert judgment in selecting appropriate implementation approaches (phased rollout, pilot, big\-bang deployment, or parallel run) based on workflow complexity, risk, and business value.
* Lead requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, and cutover planning for core CM platforms, maintaining hands\-on fluency with leading clinical and workflow management systems.
* Partner closely with line\-of\-business leaders, IT, clinical operations, vendor management, and enterprise Program Management Offices to ensure alignment with standards, architecture guardrails, and compliance requirements.
* Define and track success metrics tied to business outcomes, ensuring AI solutions reduce friction, improve effectiveness, and scale impact across teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner—translating technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations for stakeholders across varying levels of technical sophistication.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree required.
* 2\+ years of experience in technology implementation, systems configuration, or solution deployment including AI required. Fluent with a range of implementation and project management tools with demonstrated experience delivering enterprise systems.
* 3\+ years project management and cross\-functional delivery experience required. This may include cross\-functional collaboration in an enterprise environment.
* Experience in the healthcare and/or managed care industries preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative with a desire to drive significant, measurable results.
* Strong project management, analytical skills, and high attention to detail.

new_jobs.description:
Kelley Drye \& Warren LLP, a powerhouse firm with the heart of a boutique, is seeking a Revenue \& Rates Strategy Analyst to join our team. At Kelley Drye, we understand that pricing and commercial strategy extend far beyond spreadsheets. Our team applies a Legal Operations mindset to help drive value across pricing, rate management, budgeting, analytics, sales, marketing, project management, and other strategic initiatives. If you’re looking for a role where your work directly influences business outcomes and contributes to the Firm’s success, this is the opportunity for you.


The Strategic Pricing Team occupies a unique position within the Firm, partnering with every practice area and business department to provide insight into financial performance, client economics, and commercial strategy. We play a critical role in helping attorneys develop client\-centered pricing and rate strategies that support both business development objectives and strong financial results.


This position offers significant exposure to Firm Partners and Executive Committee members while working closely with the Director and Manager of Strategic Pricing and the team’s analysts. The role also collaborates extensively with attorneys, Finance, Billing, Marketing, and Business Development professionals to evaluate client and matter performance, support pricing and rate initiatives, and deliver data\-driven recommendations that balance competitiveness with profitability.


This role can be based in either our New York or Washington, D.C. office.


**How You’ll Make a Difference**


* Partner with the Director and Manager of Strategic Pricing to analyze client rates, revenue, realization, profitability, and commercial performance, identifying opportunities to improve financial outcomes to support client rate reviews, negotiations, and strategic revenue initiatives.
* Perform detailed reviews of existing client rate agreements, pricing structures, and billing performance, partnering with attorneys and the Billing team to improve realization, profitability, and client economics.
* Support quarterly client performance discussions and the Firm’s annual rate review process through analysis of client history, utilization patterns, market trends, competitive benchmarks, and financial performance.
* Assist in creating matter budgets, pricing models, and financial analyses to support day\-to\-day budget planning, alternative fee arrangements, client proposals, and RFP responses.
* Monitor budget\-to\-actual performance and track the results of pricing and revenue initiatives, leveraging historical outcomes to improve future budgeting, pricing strategies, and financial performance.

**Qualifications:**


* Minimum of 2\-4 years of experience in financial analysis, consulting, client value, procurement/sourcing, pricing, revenue management, or a similar analytical role, preferably within a Fortune 500 company, Am Law 200 law firm, or other professional services organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify trends, assess opportunities, and translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively across practices, offices, and departments while providing thoughtful, data\-driven guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present analyses, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
* Strong presentation and data visualization skills, with an eye for creating clear, intuitive, and impactful reports, dashboards, and presentations that enhance the end\-user experience.

Want to build the systems that get AWS's largest customers from AI idea to production faster? We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the mechanisms that connect customers to expert AI builder teams and then turn what those teams deliver into reusable assets that help accelerate all AWS customers.  

  

You'll operate at the center of a flywheel: customers come in with complex AI challenges, you route them to the right expertise or solution, those engagements produce proven patterns and customer signals, and you package those learnings so the next customer doesn't need high\-touch support at all. If you love designing systems that start hands\-on and end self\-service, this role is for you.

new_jobs.description:
Pritchard Industries is a dynamic and innovative provider of comprehensive facility services, dedicated to enhancing the operational efficiency of our client partners in the industries we serve. With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people.



Pritchard Industries is seeking to hire a **Project Manager** to oversee, coordinate, and supervise comprehensive Vendor Management Services for two major NYC institutional facilities totaling over 100,000 sq. ft. each. The Project Manager will serve as the primary on\-site and operational point of contact for the New York City Administration for Children's Services (ACS). You will be responsible for overseeing subcontracted vendors, managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, driving preventative maintenance and cost\-avoidance strategies, maintaining strict regulatory compliance, and ensuring 24/7/365 continuous operational readiness across both properties.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Vendor \& Subcontractor Supervision**


* Supervise, inspect, and coordinate the performance of all subcontracted vendors working on the properties.
* Ensure all vendor work complies with manufacturer recommendations, NYC Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) standards, and applicable NYC/NYS laws.
* Direct competitive procurement for third\-party services: solicit and document a minimum of 3 written estimates for purchases over $15,000 and conduct market research for purchases between $5,000 and $15,000\.
* Coordinate seamlessly with other city\-engaged contractors to prevent work interference or operational friction.


**2\. Facilities \& MEP Operations**


* Manage off\-site and on\-demand building engineering services for MEP, elevator, generator, HVAC, lighting, and fire/safety systems during normal business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).
* Dispatch emergency response staff on\-site within **1 hour** for any off\-hours system operational failures.
* Conduct an annual Property Analysis and execute an ACS\-approved Cost Avoidance \& Preventative Maintenance Program.
* Oversee hot/cold water chemical treatments, sanitation, and boiler feed water pH levels in compliance with OSHA MSDS guidelines.
* Implement and manage an Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) program, including annual IAQ reporting, biennial facility inspections, and rapid air testing within 24 hours of suspected issues.


**3\. Safety, Emergency Plans \& Compliance**


* Review, update, or create Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) and evacuation procedures annually in coordination with ACS and site staff.
* Ensure compliance with all FDNY and NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) regulations, particularly regarding elevator and life safety equipment.
* Support, coordinate and document required emergency drills (e.g., evacuation, shelter\-in\-place).


**4\. Recordkeeping, Logs \& Reporting**


* Maintain comprehensive daily operating logs, physical inventory controls, warranty files, and a dedicated maintenance library.
* Monitor security surveillance system operability (cameras, hardware, software) and report status summaries to ACS at designated intervals.
* Prepare and present reports for oversight entities (e.g., NYS Office of Children and Family Services, NYS Commission of Correction, NYC Council) upon request.
* Implement and maintain ACS\-approved Facility Management Software systems.


**5\. Labor \& Financial Administration**


* Enforce compliance with NYS Labor Law Sections 220 / 231 (Prevailing Wage / Living Wage regulations).
* Ensure all site workers complete 10\-hour OSHA construction safety certifications, display laminated photo ID badges, and sign daily sign\-in logs.
* Submit detailed monthly expense reports, payroll certifications, and original payroll transcripts to ACS.
* Promptly investigate and submit full written reports on non\-compliance notices, accidents, claims, or significant facility incidents within 24 hours.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**


**Experience \& Education:**


* **Minimum Experience:**
* At least 5 years of experience providing vendor/facilities management services for commercial or institutional properties, each measuring no less than 100,000 square feet.
* Strong technical background in commercial MEP systems, elevators, fire alarm/suppression systems, and facility management software.


**Certifications \& Compliance Knowledge:**


* Thorough working knowledge of NYC Department of Buildings (DOB), FDNY, OSHA standards, and NYC Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) guidelines.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing NYS Labor Law (Section 220 \& 231\) prevailing wage compliance, certified payrolls, and reporting.
* OSHA 10\-Hour Construction Safety Certification (or higher) required.


**Skills \& Operational Requirements:**


* **Availability:** Flexible schedule required to manage 24/7/365 coverage and respond on\-site to emergency situations within 1 hour.
* **Vendor Procurement:** Demonstrated capability in executing competitive bidding (Best Value framework), invoice auditing, and budget/cost\-control management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for interfacing with municipal government clients, labor reps, and oversight agencies.


**Benefits:**


* Full\-Time

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is seeking a Program Manager to join the Startup Integrated Planning team within the Global Engineering, Materials, \& Sustainability (GEMS) organization. This team owns the integrated planning function for North America's infrastructure project portfolio, connecting cross\-functional workstreams into unified, reliable schedules that guide execution across large\-scale new build and expansion/retrofit projects.  

  

This Program Manager will contribute to the strategic evolution of the integrated planning program, helping mature planning as a discipline. The role oversees a team of contracted project planners, setting the bar for quality and ensuring consistent delivery, while balancing program\-level strategy, cross\-functional influence, and scaling mechanisms.  

  

This is a rapidly scaling environment where processes exist but are still maturing. Success requires strategic thinking, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the judgment to refine and extend existing frameworks. A strong background in integrated scheduling is critical for providing effective program management at this scale.
  

  

This role requires up to 50% travel in the US and Canada and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Program Strategy \& Contracted Planner Oversight
  

* Shape and advance the workforce and vendor strategy for contracted planners, including capacity modeling, skill\-mix optimization, and procurement negotiations that scale with portfolio growth.
* Oversee contracted project planners: set expectations, provide training on planning standards, review deliverable quality, and support escalations.
* Assign and rebalance planners across projects based on priority, complexity, and workload.
* Track project budgets, manage invoicing, and provide funding inputs for planning resources.

  

Planning Quality, Standards, \& Governance  

* Refine and enforce quality standards for integrated project schedules, ensuring all plans connect discipline timelines, dependencies, and handovers into a single source of truth.
* Contribute to the planning maturity model and roadmap, setting progressive quality targets that evolve as the program scales.
* Design and implement governance mechanisms that validate schedule quality at scale, removing the need for manual review.
* Ensure weekly planning status reports are accurate, complete, and distributed on time to stakeholders.
* Track planning health via KPI dashboards measuring schedule integrity, milestone adherence, plan variance, and delivery date accuracy.

  

Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
  

* Develop, maintain, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures for all planning activities.
* Develop and improve planning tools, templates, and AI\-driven automations to boost planner productivity and eliminate manual workflows.
* Identify and lead initiatives that advance planning maturity, including automation, tooling, and capability building.
* Capture lessons learned from completed projects and convert them into repeatable, scalable best practices.

  

Risk Management \& Reporting
  

* Identify and mitigate program\-level planning risks; own escalation paths and drive issues to resolution.
* Ensure planners identify cross\-functional dependencies and surface risks early, before they become execution problems.
* Develop and refine risk and reporting frameworks that give leadership the signal needed to make portfolio\-level decisions
* Provide clear, data\-driven status reporting to senior leadership on portfolio\-wide planning performance.

  

Program\-Level Cross\-Functional Partnership
  

* Build and maintain program\-level relationships with key partner functions (design, operations, construction, launch, IT, engineering) to drive planning adoption and standardization.
* Serve as the planning liaison with partner functions, championing integrated scheduling practices and ensuring planning inputs are prioritized.
* Drive continuous improvement of integrated planning by gathering feedback from partner functions and refining how planning intersects with their workflows.
* Represent the Integrated Planning program in global and cross\-functional forums, aligning planning standards and resolving systemic gaps across disciplines.

------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* 3\+ years of integrated scheduling experience including use of MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent tool
* Experience applying AI tools and automation to scale program operations and drive measurable efficiency improvements.
* Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Master's degree
* Experience in construction or industrial infrastructure projects.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Middle Mile Fleet Management business is scaling fast, and preventive maintenance is central to how we keep it running. If you want to take an established program to the next level of maturity — bringing rigor, data, and mechanisms to a business that already moves at Amazon scale — this is the place for you.  

  

The Middle Mile organization operates and maintains a large, growing fleet of over 100,000 assets — tractors, trailers, box trucks, and hostlers. In this role you will raise the bar on how we maintain those assets, wearing many hats in a highly collaborative environment. This role requires strong leadership, the ability to identify trends with limited data, and the influence to align teams across Amazon to advance our maintenance business.  

  

This Program Manager will own the vision, roadmap, and end\-to\-end execution of Amazon's Preventive Maintenance (PM) strategy for the Middle Mile fleet. Preventive maintenance is the single largest lever we have to maximize asset uptime, reduce unplanned breakdowns, extend asset life, and lower total cost of ownership across the fleet.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the PM strategy and roadmap. Define the multi\-year vision for scheduled maintenance across tractors, trailers, box trucks, and hostlers — setting the PM cadence, compliance targets, and completion standards that maximize uptime while balancing shop capacity, network availability, and cost.  

Drive measurable reliability outcomes. Move the metrics that matter — VORR/uptime, PM and PMDOT compliance, MTBF/MTBG, unplanned downtime, and cost per mile — using data to catch failure trends before they become breakdowns.  

Smooth and optimize PM volume. Work backwards from network demand and shop capacity to level PM workload across the year, including peak\-period planning, so maintenance stays on schedule without disrupting operations.  

Own and build the reliability tooling. Build the AI\-driven mechanisms — automated WBR pipelines, QuickSight downtime dashboards, and deep\-dive generation — that surface failure trends and drive the right maintenance actions at scale.  

Hold vendors and OEMs accountable. Enforce quality through data\-driven scorecards and 3rd\-party audits, feeding reliability learnings into future asset purchases.  

Influence across the org. Align Operations, Finance, Capital Planning, vendor networks, and senior leadership — balancing long\-term strategy with day\-to\-day execution.

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

This opportunity resides with All\-Domain Operations (ADO), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All\-Domain Operations comprises multi\-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.
  
  

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision\-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.
  
  

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies
  
  

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

HII\-Mission Technologies is seeking a Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) mid\-level specialist to serve in The Office of National Security (ONS), within the Immediate Office of the Secretary at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), which manages Department\-wide programs and provides oversight, policy direction, standards, and performance assessments in the areas of counterintelligence, intelligence, insider threat, cyber threat intelligence, information security, national personnel security, homeland security, and the safeguarding of classified information.

Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Peraton is seeking a **Business Analyst** to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position will be located in Herndon, VA with some remote work possible. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Bureau of Diplomatic Technology (DT). This position requires excellent interpersonal skills with customer\-facing experience and expertise in running demos, documentation and data analysis. Your ability to articulate, coordinate, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify business challenges, gather and analyze data, and provide actionable recommendations will be key to your success in this role. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data analytics. new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**



**Intelligence Analyst**

  




**About M1 Global**



Since 1994, M1 Global has grown from a local security provider to the trusted security partner of Fortune 500 companies worldwide. We build security programs for complex enterprise environments — from loading docks to data centers, headquarters to event venues — powered by Aurix™, our proprietary automation platform. We are part of the Specialized family of brands.



**Protecting the companies that power the world.**

**The Role**



The Intelligence Analyst is the senior analytical seat in the operation. You monitor an all\-hazards picture for client critical infrastructure across multiple sites in a disperse geographical areas severe weather, grid and utility disruption, civil unrest and protest activity, crime and targeted violence, unauthorized drone activity, transportation and supply disruption, wildfire, seismic activity, and public health events. You calculate what each event actually threatens, and you communicate that judgment to the people who act on it.



**Key Responsibilities**



**All\-Hazards Monitoring**



* Monitor a defined portfolio of sites continuously for natural, technological, human\-caused, and geopolitical hazards.



* Run open\-source intelligence collection across news, government, utility, meteorological, transportation, and social sources — and verify before you report.



* Maintain persistent awareness of regional conditions surrounding each assigned site, including power and water availability, road and airspace status, and local civil activity.



* Track developing situations through resolution and update stakeholders as the picture changes.



**Risk Calculation and Assessment**



* Assess every event against three factors — proximity to the site, severity of the hazard, and incident or risk type — and produce a defensible risk determination from them.



* Apply the program’s scoring and threshold criteria consistently, so the same event produces the same call regardless of who is on shift.



* Distinguish credible threats from noise. Explain the reasoning behind each call, not just the conclusion.



* Identify second\-order effects: what a hazard disrupts downstream, and which sites inherit the consequence.



* Recommend threshold and criteria adjustments to leadership when event patterns show the current settings are miscalibrated.



**Stakeholder Communication and Escalation**



* Notify the right stakeholders at the right time, matched to proximity, severity, and risk type — site leadership, regional leadership, operations, and client security leadership.



* Write and deliver alerts that state the hazard, the affected site, the assessed impact, and the recommended action. Bottom line first.



* Escalate through defined paths without delay, and confirm receipt on time\-critical notifications.



* Serve as the analytical voice during crisis coordination — give leadership the picture they need to decide, in the time they have to decide it.



* Brief technical and non\-technical audiences with the same clarity.



**Intelligence Production and Reporting**



* Produce daily intelligence briefs covering the previous 24 hours and the day ahead, written for site and regional leads.



* Produce weekly summaries with emerging indicators and a forward outlook.



* Answer requests for information with sourced, analyst\-produced assessments inside agreed turnaround times.



* Build trend analysis that identifies recurring risk exposure across the portfolio and informs mitigation planning.



* Document every assessment so it holds up on later review.



**Program Support**



* Support drills, tabletop exercises, and after\-action reviews.



* Contribute to standard operating procedures, escalation matrices, and notification templates — and keep them current as conditions change.



* Work inside client systems, procedures, and reporting standards. One process, not a second one to reconcile.



**Required Qualifications**



* Five or more years of intelligence analysis, threat monitoring, or security operations experience — or equivalent practical experience.



* Bachelor’s degree in intelligence studies, international relations, emergency management, criminal justice, geography, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.



* Demonstrated background in one or more of: military or government intelligence, law enforcement, corporate security, or emergency management.



* Working command of structured analytic techniques and cognitive bias mitigation.



* Open\-source intelligence tradecraft, including source verification and digital hygiene.



* Proven written clarity under time pressure. Bottom\-line\-up\-front writing built for executive decisions.



* Experience assessing risk by proximity, severity, and hazard type, and escalating on defined criteria.



* Proficiency with commercial intelligence and event\-monitoring platforms, geospatial and mapping tools, mass notification systems, and case management platforms.



* Availability for any shift in a 24/7/365 operation, including nights, weekends, and holidays.



* Ability to pass all pre\-employment screening and meet local licensing requirements.



**Preferred Qualifications**



* Experience supporting data centers, critical infrastructure, or a multi\-site enterprise portfolio.



* Experience in multi\-national operations.



* Experience building or tuning risk scoring models, alert thresholds, or geofenced monitoring criteria.



* Crisis management or emergency operations center experience.



* Industry certification — ASIS CPP or PSP, ATAP Certified Threat Manager, GIAC Open Source Intelligence (GOSI), FEMA Professional Development Series, or equivalent.



* Experience mentoring or training analysts.



**Key Competencies**



**All\-Hazards Analysis**  


**Risk Calculation**

new_jobs.title: Principal Data Analyst - Office of the Chief Data Officer, Central Analytics and Reporting
new_jobs.description:
Principal Data Analyst \- Office of the Chief Data Officer, Central Analytics and Reporting
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.


Join the Analytics \& Transformation team and help shape the future of data management at Capital One. You’ll sit at the heart of our enterprise\-wide data strategy, partnering with Data Managers, Product Managers, Engineers, Risk Managers, Business Analysts, and executives to define, standardize, and deliver the metrics that measure the health of our data. You’ll turn data risk metrics into insights and action, evolve our measurement capabilities as policies and business needs change, and serve as a strategic thought partner to stakeholders and senior leadership.

  

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well\-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

  

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:


What You’ll Do

* Partner across LOBs to define, standardize, and publish enterprise data risk metrics.
* Build and evolve dashboards and data products that provide visibility into data management and governance.
* Monitor metrics, identify emerging risks and trends, and generate actionable insights for leaders.
* Translate evolving data policies and requirements into meaningful metrics and monitoring.
* Use AI to automate and transform how we create, manage, and consume data risk metrics.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Present insights and recommendations to Senior Director\+ leaders and executives across Capital One.
* Challenge the status quo and help shape the long\-term strategy for data management.

  

Innovation

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well\-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self\-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

  

Business Intelligence

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

  

Data Management

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

  

Our ideal candidate will have:

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
* Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

  

Why This Role Matters:


Your work will directly influence how Capital One measures and improves the health of its data. You’ll gain broad executive visibility, deliver measurable impact on critical risk outcomes, and become a key thought leader in making our data well\-managed and easy to govern.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
* At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
* At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
* At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
* At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

 **Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.**


The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

new_jobs.description:
At Battelle, experience matters, especially when addressing the complexities of chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosives (CBRNE) challenges. For over 70 years, government agencies and industries have trusted us to provide solutions for some of their most critical CBRNE issues. Battelle is home to advanced facilities and leading industry experts who deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from threat awareness to complex systems integration—ensuring the nation is prepared to respond to both current and emerging threats. Our commitment to safety and innovation makes us a leader in the field, dedicated to protecting national security and public safety.

**Job Summary**
---------------



We are currently seeking a CBRN Analyst. This position is a full\-time opportunity located in Washington, D.C. (Pentagon, client site).  

Battelle has been providing research, development, test, and evaluation services in support of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) defense for over 60 years. As part of our mission support, Battelle is working with the U.S. Army G8 – Capability Development (CD) Directorate to advance the resourcing, equipping, and modernization of CBRN defense capabilities. Our support facilitates the advancement of CBRND systems for next\-generation CBRN sensing, threat warning, reporting, hazard prediction, protection, and mitigation.


In this role, the selected individual will coordinate across integrated Layered Protection portfolios to align requirements, resources, acquisition activities, and senior leader engagement across the Services. They will also synchronize CBRN modernization efforts with broader Joint and Service initiatives, ensuring defense systems remain effective against evolving global threats.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



As a CBRN Analyst, the selected individual will serve as a key synchronization resource within the Chemical and Biological Defense Program, supporting the U.S. Army's Executive Agent responsibilities across military and interagency stakeholders. Responsibilities may include:

* Serving as a Synchronization Officer (SSO) within the Chemical and Biological Defense Program (CBDP) Branch, Formation\-Based Layered Protection (FBLP) Warfighting Division, Capability Directorate, HQDA G\-8, synchronizing activities across the Military Services, Joint Staff, and interagency stakeholders
* Developing and communicating the Executive Agent narrative on portfolio status, resourcing, and emerging issues to support senior leader awareness and enterprise synchronization
* Coordinating, assessing, and analyzing CBRN defense doctrinal, operational, tactical, and training requirements using DOTmLPF\-P (Doctrine, Organization, Training, Materiel, Leadership, Personnel, Facilities, and Policy) analysis
* Developing White Papers addressing CBRND requirements, initiatives, and challenges
* Conducting reviews and assessments of business management and governance policy, guidance, and agreements to identify gaps, efficiencies, and improvements, and initiating revisions or development of policy in accordance with DoW and HQDA guidance
* Facilitating coordination among the Services, Joint partners, and program offices to support emerging requirements, contingency operations, and senior leader decision\-making
* Monitoring and responding to classified and unclassified tasks from HQDA and DoW, ensuring CBRN\-related queries are answered with technical accuracy
**Key Qualifications**
----------------------


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent prior military experience
* Minimum of five (5\) years of experience in CBRN defense
* CBRND technical literacy
* Proficiency in Microsoft Access and Excel
* Active Secret clearance required; must be a U.S. citizen
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a STEM field
* Five to ten years of experience in Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) or CBRN defense
* DAWIA certification in Program Management (or willingness to obtain)
* Active Top Secret/SCI clearance

new_jobs.description:
**340B Program Analyst**


Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life\-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. Our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.


The 340B Program Analyst will play a key role in ensuring the organization’s 340B program meets regulatory and compliance requirements. This position will design, build, and test Epic functionality to support 340B compliance, while monitoring program requirements to ensure successful annual recertification. The analyst will also plan and conduct comprehensive 340B program audits, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide clear status updates and recommendations to leadership.

 **As a successful candidate, you will:**

* Analyze, develop, configure, test, and implement 340B logic in Epic.
* Configure and manage 340B cost updates and med lists in Epic.
* Provide expertise in building and managing Epic rules for 340B compliance.
* Develop data specifications and flowcharts to align 340B Epic build and logic with operational workflows.
* Effectively troubleshoot problems, identify root causes, and recommend solutions.
* Manage internal and external tickets through resolution.
* Design, validate, configure, and test 340B logic for Epic Willow Inventory.
* Design and validate data feeds for the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) 340B database.
* Design, develop, and validate 340B reports and dashboards.
* Lead and facilitate technical meetings to gather data requirements from key stakeholders.
* Develop downtime procedure, run impact analysis reports, and implement corrective actions.
* Prepare detailed audit reports with findings, supportive documentation, and recommendations.
* Prepare and present financial and compliance metrics.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.
**Your qualifications should include:**

* Bachelor's Degree; 3 additional years of experience plus the minimum experience requirement may substitute for minimum education
* 3\+ years hospital experience in a technical, clinical, or 340B operations or audit role
* Valid CA Pharmacy Technician License
* Epic Certification in Willow Inpatient or 340B ACE Certification, preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in operational hospital setting, 340B operations or auditing, or 340B contract pharmacies, preferred

**City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.**

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Our Process Improvement Specialists are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Process Imp. Specialist, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long\-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Ensure cross\-departmental collaboration to ensure that all relevant teams are aligned and engaged in the change initiatives.  

Engage impacted stakeholders to evaluate the risks associated with proposed changes and to serve as the approval authority for change requests.  

Responsible for assessing the operations readiness for change and coordinating all change management activities.  

Engaging stakeholders, creating communication plans, and building networks of change champions to facilitate the transition.  

Continuously evaluating and improving the change management process to enhance its effectiveness and efficiency  

Ensure collaboration with NA CM teams for parity on changes with WW impacts  

Monitor the execution of change management activities to ensure alignment with the overall change strategy.  

  

A day in the life  

As PIS, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data\-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programmes. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on\-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.  

  

About the team  

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we’re changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better. We have ambitious plans to expand our specialist fulfilment centres and delivery stations across the UK and Europe. While those of us who work in delivery stations will do some night shifts, most of us work during the day. Our team is made up of people across operations, supply chain, business intelligence and programme management, and everyone plays a crucial role in growing this part of the business.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree, or Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience leading process improvements
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partner well with people at all levels within an organization, including coaching of junior staff
* Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
* Experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems, or experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership
* Experience building cross\-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
* Experience leading cross\-functional projects and implementing strategic initiatives
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders

Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. SMC primarily relies on carefully chosen external partners to select individual securities, allowing Stanford to benefit from specialized knowledge in asset classes that reward superior active management.  



SMC is seeking an organized and detail\-oriented Trade \& Cash Operations Analyst who will report to the Manager, Trade \& Cash Operations. This position is critical for facilitating securities transactions and cash movements while providing key investment information to the SMC investment team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate high productivity, meticulous attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills, with proven experience in equity and fixed income security settlement and cash flow management.

* Facilitate securities transactions, complex securities, settlements, and reconciliations.
* Monitor all investment approvals and activity, accurately record activity, and serve as the primary interface with internal and external parties.

*\*Other duties may also be assigned*

The expected pay range for this position is is $92,000 \- $120,000 per annum.


  
**Core Duties** :


* Calculate performance and perform structured analysis of results for marketable and non\-marketable investments.
* Provide effective, relevant, and focused financial management reports and dashboards. Identify and investigate discrepancies and underlying issues in reporting; recognize exceptions, develop solutions that may require policy changes or development of new reports and/or dashboards.
* Provide portfolio and asset allocation reporting. Run, maintain, reconcile, review, combine, analyze and validate financial data sets, utilizing financial databases and key financial information from multiple systems including Solovis, Bloomberg, and others.
* Prepare fund movements for authorization including internal cash transfers, wire set\-up, and investment funding. Resolve issues, recognize exceptions and recommend solutions.
* Process, record, and perform recurring investment accounting activities and maintain integrity of accounting and investment data for Merged Pool and School \& Department Funds investments.
* Collect data and perform research on details of transactions. Ensure work complies with complex internal policies and external regulations which may require interpretation.
* Onboard new investments, ensuring that all investments are accurately set up in custodian’s and Stanford’s systems. Deposit key investment manager materials on internal data storage system.
* Prepare, track, and process investment valuations, transactions, and corporate actions. Ensure related documentation is completed and archived. Prepare reconciliations to custodian records.
* Work as a member of a project team and contribute to change management strategy through communication and collaboration with others.
* Serve as a first line resource to brokers and custodian bank; identify and resolve issues.
* Interface with key internal and external stakeholders, including exhibiting a strong customer service orientation.

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Associate’s degree or combination of education and work experience.


Bachelor’s degree and two years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant work experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Experience with a variety of investment types (public and private).
* Understanding of and ability to apply accounting skills and concepts. Knowledge of and experience with accounting systems.
* Proficiency in business applications, such as Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel.

* High degree of accuracy, strong attention to detail, and efficient execution of responsibilities
* Robust organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload, set deadlines independently, and complete tasks in a timely and efficient manner.
* Strong communication skills, including ability to prepare materials for and clearly and effectively communicate information to internal and external audiences, client groups, and management.
